description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the 'git blame' command, specifically testing the --ignore-rev and related options, as well as various edge cases and heuristics involved in blaming lines in a file. It sets up git repositories, commits, tags, and checks blame output under different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs a shell command or sequence of commands, and verifies the result.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and verifies the failure.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a string in a file's output or error message.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a file with specified content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to ensure commit timestamps differ.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge of two branches or commits.
